card.title: Marketing Head

detail.rawHtml:
Job highlights
  • Bachelor's or Master's in Marketing or Business Administration from reputed institute, 10-12 years in market planning and marketing management, expertise in market research and public relations
  • Lead marketing department, develop strategic marketing plans and campaigns, manage stakeholder relationships, drive sales strategies, and oversee public relations to promote brand

Job description

Manukabir Enterprises Private Limited, promoted by the Jaypee Group, is a well-established apparel manufacturing company located in Bulandshahar, Uttar Pradesh. Specializing in the production of a variety of high-quality garments, including shirts and trousers, sweatshirts , T- shirts polo, top, cord-set etc. the company is committed to delivering excellence in design and craftsmanship.


The organization operates with a focus on innovation, quality, and meeting global market standards. With a robust infrastructure and a skilled workforce, Manukabir Enterprises caters to the growing demand for premium apparel in both domestic and international markets.


Roles & Responsibilities: This is a full-time, on-site role for a Marketing Head located in Noida. The Marketing Head will lead the marketing department, overseeing all market planning, marketing strategies, and campaigns. Responsibilities include conducting detailed market research, managing relationships with stakeholders, and driving sales strategies. The role will also involve managing public relations initiatives to promote the company's brand and products effectively. The Marketing Head will act as the key driver for business growth through innovative and result-oriented approaches.


Qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field preferably from NIFT or any other reputed institute.


Skill & Experience:

  • Min 10-12 years' experience with Experience and Expertise in Market Planning and Marketing Management, with experience in creating strategic marketing plans and campaigns.
  • Strong abilities in Market Research and understanding market trends, customer preferences, and industry benchmarks.
  • Proven track record in Sales, with skills in developing business opportunities and achieving revenue targets.
  • Proficiency in building and maintaining Public Relations to strengthen the organization's brand presence and stakeholder relationships. Strong leadership and team management skills, with experience in leading cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities to make data-driven marketing decisions.
  • Previous experience in the apparel manufacturing or textile industry is desirable
